packs.name: Imaging
packs.description: Headless image editing with ImageMagick: trim, resize, pad, outline, drop shadow and PNG optimization.

steps.title: Install ImageMagick 7
steps.detail: Required. Unify installs it for you; Windows may ask for permission once. If that fails, run the Windows x64 installer from the download page and keep "Add application directory to your system path" checked.
steps.error: Installer failed with exit code: 1602 (cancelled by the user)

steps.title: Add oxipng (optional)
steps.detail: Makes PNGs smaller without losing quality.

steps.title: Add pngquant (optional)
steps.detail: Makes PNGs much smaller by reducing colours. On Windows, put pngquant.exe in a folder on your PATH.

steps.title: Add rembg for background removal (optional)
steps.detail: Needs Python 3. It downloads its model the first time it runs.

steps.title: Add Real-ESRGAN for upscaling (optional)
steps.detail: Unzip realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan from the releases page and set the DSH_REALESRGAN_PATH environment variable to its .exe.
